The '''Diamond''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]] that can be obtained primarily from [[Mining#Diamond Node|Diamond Node]]s and [[Mining#Gem Node|Gem Node]]s in [[the Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]], [[Quarry]], and [[Volcano Dungeon]]. After reading [[The Diamond Hunter]], any rock has a small chance of yielding a Diamond when mined by hand. Diamonds may also be obtained in a number of other ways.

The Lost Book ''[[Lost Books#A Study on Diamond Yields|A Study on Diamond Yields]]'' contains information about the chances of finding diamond nodes in the mines on a given floor.

A Diamond is arguably the best gem to duplicate in the [[Crystalarium]], providing the largest source of money as a gem. Diamonds are also liked or loved by all giftable NPCs. 

If a player has not received 4 candles from [[Grandpa#Grandpa's Evaluation|Grandpa's Evaluation]], then they may be re-evaluated at any time by placing a Diamond into [[The Farm#Grandpa's Shrine|Grandpa's Shrine]].

==Locations==
*[[Mining#Diamond Node|Diamond Node]]s and [[Mining#Gem Node|Gem Node]]s in [[the Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]], [[Quarry]], and [[Volcano Dungeon]]. Diamond Nodes are only found on Floors 50+ in the Mines.
*Any rock mined with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]], after obtaining the power from [[The Diamond Hunter]] (0.66% chance).
*[[Volcano Dungeon#Metal Crates|Metal crates]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]].
*Red, Purple, Copper, or Iron [[Slimes|Slime]], [[Dwarvish Sentry]], [[Duggy]], [[Iridium Golem]], or [[Wilderness Golem]] drop.
*Any [[Monsters|Monster]] after reaching the bottom of the Mines (0.05% chance). 
*[[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] (regular and golden).
*[[Pans|Panning]] in any area.
*Any [[Garbage Can]] after reaching the bottom of the Mines.
*One Diamond is one of the prizes from the [[Trout Derby]] festival. 
*Five Diamonds can be obtained as the 20th prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]].
*An [[Ice Pip]] or [[Stonefish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce a Diamond when the population of the pond reaches 9. 
*The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces seven Diamonds per year on the birthdays of [[Evelyn]], [[Gus]], [[Jodi]], [[Krobus]], [[Marnie]], [[Maru]], and [[Willy]], as well as having a 25% chance to produce one daily on non-birthdays.

==Tailoring==
Diamond is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt224.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring|Pendant Shirt]]. It is a white [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*The Diamond may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|2250}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.  The Diamond will never be requested until the player has reached floor 40 of [[The Mines]].
*One or two Diamonds may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].
*One Diamond may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.

==Trading==
*One Diamond can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Triple Shot Espresso]].
*Ten Diamonds can be traded to the [[Volcano Dungeon#Shop|Volcano Dwarf]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] for [[The Diamond Hunter]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. Can be produced by [[Fish Pond]]s and obtained from Copper and Iron Slimes. Can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]].}}
{{History|1.5|Can now be used in [[Fairy Dust]] and [[Geode Crusher]] recipes. Can be used in [[Forge|Forging]]. Is now an option in the Treasure Hunter's Bundle. Can now be obtained from the [[Volcano Dungeon]] and Dwarvish Sentries.}}
{{History|1.6|Now one of the prizes from the [[Trout Derby]] festival and a prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]]. Can be obtained from [[Iridium Golem]]s. Can be traded for [[The Diamond Hunter]], which allows any rock to drop Diamonds. May now be requested by the Raccoon.}}
